title: Fabricating highly hydrophobic thermoplastic starch/polyvinyl alcohol composites via twin-screw extrusion using citric acid–chitosan co-plasticizers

CA–Cs co-plasticization induces esterification and N-acetyl interactions, forming a cross-linked TPS/PVA network that enhances compatibility, surface smoothness, hydrophobicity (contact angle ≈110°), and processing stability at 10 wt% CA.
